course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Design a 9-ft single angel tension member to support a dead tensile working load of 30 k and live tensile working load of 40 k. The member is to be connected to one leg only with 7/8-in bolts (at least four in a line 3 in a on center). Assume that only one bolt is to be located at any one cross section. Use A36 steel with $\mathsf { F } _ { \mathsf { y } } = 3 6$ ksi and $\mathsf { F } _ { \mathsf { u } } = 5 8 \mathsf { k s i }$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
